_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 55 (Bruh Nebula): the ✨ Suggested merges dialog is clearer from your two screenshots. The surviving identity now wears a ★ merge target badge (so you can tell which row becomes the 'common course' above), the confusing duplicate rows are gone (a fix to how the list is built — 20 of them), the Discipline box now disables + explains itself, and there's a new '⌕ merge into a different existing course' search so you can fold a group into, say, a real Anatomy & Physiology C-ID. You also approved renaming the long UC-CUR ids to a clean SUBJ + Z + number form (e.g. BIOL Z9001) — that's scoped; the dry-run is next on Fable's go. Hard-refresh to see the worklist changes.

items.text: Open ✨ Suggested merges and try the new clarity: the ★ merge target marks the row that survives + takes the title above; with only 2 candidates just Confirm or Skip (don't deselect either). Try '⌕ merge into a different existing course instead…' to redirect a group to an existing C-ID/M-ID the suggestions didn't offer.

You approved renaming the 4,053 long UC-CUR ids → SUBJ Z<band><number> (e.g. BIOL Z9001; Z = curator-minted, needs attention). Fable will DRY-RUN it first for your review (alias map + counts) before anything changes. Say go when you want the dry-run — and confirm the format if you'd like a tweak.

✨ Suggested merges still holds the 🏷 title-similarity lane (~5,457 groups) awaiting human eyes. Say the word and Fable will DRY-RUN a high-cosine, cross-college, band-gated pass 2 (same reversible planner as the auto-merge) for your review before anything applies.

Second-look the auto-merge cohort: CCR → Triage → 'Auto-merged' lists all 2,272 bot-merged courses (⚙ chip marks them inline). Expand a few ⛓ merged rows — anything off, tell Fable; one row or the whole cohort can be reverted.

ARTS M1201's discipline 'Ceramic Technology' is a real MQ name but isn't in the canonical-SUBJ4 map, so the SUBJ4 fold skips it. Your call: add a canonical SUBJ4 for 'Ceramic Technology' (a _CANON_SUBJ4:: pick) or re-curate the row to 'Art'.

MilStudents dataset: ping Fable when it's live in the Custom Reports module — that wires the true JSTs-uploaded universe into the Veteran card and unlocks the other gaps you mentioned (aggregates only, no student IDs).

On Sam's go: dry-run the title-lane pass 2 — extend kb/_auto_merge_worklist.py with a title-lane config (high cosine + cross-college + band-purity gates), emit a receipt under kb/automerge_out/, present counts. DO NOT apply without sign-off.

Wire a one-click revert affordance for an individual auto-merged row (whole-cohort revert = delete reviewer_email='automerge-v1@bot'). Consider the ⚙ chip on the CSR/CER if they surface merged identities.
